alerts_state_valid.name: alerts_state_valid
alerts_state_valid.value: ("alerts"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "alerts"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("alerts"."status" = 'RESOLVED' AND "alerts"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

audit_logs_actor_valid.name: audit_logs_actor_valid
audit_logs_actor_valid.value: ("audit_logs"."actor_kind"='anonymous' AND "audit_logs"."actor_id" IS NULL) OR ("audit_logs"."actor_kind"='system' AND "audit_logs"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_logs"."actor_id" IN ('telemetry-ingestor','alert-evaluator','operation-evaluator'))

commands_execution_times_required.name: commands_execution_times_required
commands_execution_times_required.value: "commands"."execution_status" = 'NOT_REPORTED' OR ("commands"."execution_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "commands"."execution_started_received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "commands"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "commands"."execution_started_at" >= "commands"."created_at" AND "commands"."execution_started_at" < "commands"."expires_at" AND ("commands"."execution_status" = 'RUNNING' OR ("commands"."execution_result_at" IS NOT NULL AND "commands"."execution_result_received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "commands"."execution_result_at" >= "commands"."execution_started_at")))

groups_name_valid.name: groups_name_valid
groups_name_valid.value: length(btrim("groups"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "groups"."name" = btrim("groups"."name") AND "groups"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

ota_attempt_times_valid.name: ota_attempt_times_valid
ota_attempt_times_valid.value: ("ota_attempts"."started_at" IS NULL AND "ota_attempts"."expires_at" IS NULL AND "ota_attempts"."result_deadline" IS NULL AND "ota_attempts"."delivery_status"='HELD') OR ("ota_attempts"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ota_attempts"."expires_at"="ota_attempts"."started_at"+interval '300 seconds' AND "ota_attempts"."result_deadline"="ota_attempts"."started_at"+interval '600 seconds' AND "ota_attempts"."delivery_status"<>'HELD')

ota_outbox_held_valid.name: ota_outbox_held_valid
ota_outbox_held_valid.value: ("ota_outbox"."status"='HELD' AND "ota_outbox"."payload" IS NULL AND "ota_outbox"."expires_at" IS NULL AND "ota_outbox"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL AND "ota_outbox"."attempts"=0) OR ("ota_outbox"."status"<>'HELD' AND "ota_outbox"."payload" IS NOT NULL AND "ota_outbox"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
